text.content: Test whether removing the main policy's absolute visual-memory token and per-layer conditioning bypasses forces causal use of object-local temporal deltas when the delta is available only through the final multiplicative gate and directional residual.

Eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete 8-rank checkpoint; absolute-memory main context token count and per-layer conditioned RMS remain exactly zero; zero intervention gives exactly zero object-delta main contribution; slot absolute cosine is below 0.95 and both contrastive margins exceed 0.05; aligned main action loss is at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffle on the matched 2048-sample validation. No 20k unless every gate passes.

R4 model-only warm start; train complete strong_action_expert; absolute visual-memory main context and absolute-memory main conditioners disabled; final object-delta gate/residual enabled; delta-conditioned layers=0; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched none/zero/shuffle validation.
RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; same data and held-out stream as R4/R5; no future lookup.
wam@208.64.254.190; pyrogpucompute1; cwam-b4-runtime:ngc25.09-ffmpeg6; /data0/wam/cwam-b4/env/cosmos-cu130; offline model assets.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and gains; main context token count; absolute/delta conditioned RMS; applied delta RMS and ratio; slot cosine; positive/negative margins; action-gradient validity; step time; GPU memory/utilization/power.

Current vision, task, proprioception, action history, and control-memory inputs remain unchanged. Only object-memory access is restricted: absolute object slots remain privileged for auxiliary supervision but cannot enter the main action path; the main policy receives object memory only through latest-minus-previous same-slot deltas at its final update.
